candidate_membership_rule: allocate 200 prompt groups by largest remainder over candidate source shares, break quota ties by source id, rank each source by sha256(selection_seed, source_id, prompt_group_id), and take the required prefix
why: all candidates use the same source-stratified starting-policy evidence
every candidate contains the same number of prompt groups and attempts
fixed-source memberships remain identical across candidates
nested hash prefixes preserve common support when the two exchanged source shares change
required_before_freeze: starting checkpoint, tokenizer, sampler, and rollout runtime are pinned
all eleven source revisions, licenses, qualification rules, and task identities are pinned
the 245 prompt groups are selected without candidate-training outcomes
the complete attempt budget and infrastructure-failure policy are accepted
advancement: freeze a new immutable contract before launching any starting-policy attempts
